instruction: Copy all files in the "/tmp/test_files" directory that were last modified 30 days ago to a backup directory at "/tmp/backup_30days"

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'BACKUP_COUNT=$(find /tmp/backup_30days -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); OLD_COUNT=$(find /tmp/test_files/old_files -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); NEW_COUNT=$(find /tmp/test_files/new_files -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$BACKUP_COUNT" -eq 2 ] && [ "$OLD_COUNT" -eq 2 ] && [ "$NEW_COUNT" -eq 2 ]; then echo "Success: Old files copied to backup, all originals preserved"; else echo "Fail: BACKUP=$BACKUP_COUNT OLD=$OLD_COUNT NEW=$NEW_COUNT"; fi'

include: Success: Old files copied to backup, all originals preserved

metadata.explanation: Task requires copying old files (30+ days) to /tmp/backup_30days while keeping originals intact. Verification checks that 2 files exist in backup directory, 2 files remain in old_files, and 2 files remain in new_files. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification failure: Evaluator only checks file counts in predefined directories (old_files, new_files, backup_30days) but does not verify that copied files actually have modification times of 30 days ago

Missing core requirement verification: The evaluator assumes setup script organizes files into old_files/new_files directories rather than checking actual mtime values, making it impossible to verify the 30-day selection criteria
Weak correctness guarantee: The evaluator would pass even if wrong files were copied (e.g., copying new_files instead of old_files) as long as file counts match (2+2+2)
Incomplete coverage: Does not verify file identity, names, or attributes - only counts files in directories
Logic flaw: Success condition 'BACKUP_COUNT=2 AND OLD_COUNT=2 AND NEW_COUNT=2' does not guarantee that the 2 files in backup are the same as (or copies of) the 2 files in old_files
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification that files in /tmp/backup_30days have modification times approximately 30 days old using 'find /tmp/backup_30days -type f -mtime +29 -mtime -31' or similar
Add verification that copied file names/checksums match the old files: compare file lists or use checksums/stat to verify identity
Use a command that compares file lists: 'diff <(ls -1 /tmp/test_files/old_files | sort) <(ls -1 /tmp/backup_30days | sort)' to ensure correct files were copied
Verify the actual mtime criteria on source files before counting: 'find /tmp/test_files -type f -mtime +29 -mtime -31 | wc -l' to confirm 2 files meet the criteria
Add check that /tmp/test_files/new_files files do NOT appear in backup (to verify correct selection logic)
